query: UPDATE jobs SET state='succeeded',payload=CASE WHEN kind='webhook' THEN (payload-'token') #- '{event,data}' #- '{event,truncated}' ELSE payload-'token' END,claim_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error='',finished_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1 AND state='running' AND claim_token=$2 AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()
